lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distributed high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular rows along the mid-to-posterior flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs on the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a high-to-low vertical luminance gradient.
